en: Color photograph of a rural European village scene. In the foreground is a paved parking area with several 1960s–1970s cars, including a white sedan and green and red station wagons. Behind them stands a light-colored, three-story gabled building with a dark roof, likely a guesthouse or small hotel, with children visible near the entrance. In the background are traditional half‑timbered houses and farm buildings spread at the base of a green, tree-covered hill under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
